subject: general
question:
The profit (in Rupees) earned by four companies in the different quarters of the year 2020 are shown in the chart. The data shown is in crores.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3452536b8f753c6c36d742b34588bb4621ef6c243ef35f2908452e04b68aed4d.png] 

How much is the average profit earned by ITC in the year 2020?
solution:
**Given:**

The profit (in Rupees) earned by four companies in the different quarters of the year 2020 are shown in the chart.

**Formula used:**

Average = total profit / number of years

**Calculation:**

For ITC,

Average = 1300 + 1500 +1400 +1100 / 4 

⇒ 5300 / 4 

⇒ 1325 crore

**∴ The correct answer is 1325.**
